abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

abilities.description:
Some units have ‘Scouts x"’ listed in their abilities. If every model in a unit has this ability, then at the start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins, it can make a Normal move of up to x", with the exception that, while making that move, the distance moved by each model in that unit can be greater than that model's Move characteristic, as long as it is not greater than x".

DEDICATED TRANSPORT models can make use of any Scouts x" ability listed in their abilities, or a Scouts x" ability that a unit that starts the battle embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT model has (provided only models with this ability are embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT model), regardless of how that embarked unit gained this ability (e.g. listed in their abilities, conferred by an Enhancement or by an attached CHARACTER, etc.).

A unit that moves using this ability must end that move more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models. If both players have units that can do this, the player who is taking the first turn moves their units first.

Example: A unit has the Scouts 6" ability. At the start of the first battle round, the controlling player can make a Normal move with that unit of up to 6".

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

DEDICATED TRANSPORT models can make use of any Scouts x" ability listed in their abilities, or a Scouts x" ability that a unit that starts the battle embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT model has (provided only models with this ability are embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT model), regardless of how that embarked unit gained this ability (e.g. listed in their abilities, conferred by an Enhancement or by an attached CHARACTER, etc.).

A unit that moves using this ability must end that move more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models. If both players have units that can do this, the player who is taking the first turn moves their units first.

Example: A unit has the Scouts 6" ability. At the start of the first battle round, the controlling player can make a Normal move with that unit of up to 6".

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.

  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

abilities.name: Feel No Pain
abilities.description:
Some models have ‘Feel No Pain x+’ listed in their abilities. Each time a model with this ability suffers damage and so would lose a wound (including wounds lost due to mortal wounds), roll one D6: if the result is greater than or equal to the number denoted by ‘x’, that wound is ignored and is not lost. If a model has more than one Feel No Pain ability, you can only use one of those abilities each time that model suffers damage and so would lose a wound.

  • Feel No Pain x+: Each time this model would lose a wound, roll one D6: if the result equals or exceeds ‘x’, that wound is not lost.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

There are three units within 6" of that destroyed model, so its controlling player rolls one D3 for each of them, inflicting mortal wounds accordingly.

A unit that moves using this ability must end that move more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy models. If both players have units that can do this, the player who is taking the first turn moves their units first.

Example: A unit has the Scouts 6" ability. At the start of the first battle round, the controlling player can make a Normal move with that unit of up to 6".

Additional Effect: You can select one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit engaged with your unit and roll one D6:
  • On a 1-2, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
  • On a 3-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
  • On a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: From the Hall of Armouries
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [Devastating Wounds].

enhancements.name: Radiant Mantle
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls.

stratagems.name: IN AURAMITE CLAD
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding CUSTODIAN WARDENS units).

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: SUPERHUMAN FOCUS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of any phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not readied.

EFFECT: Your unit is readied.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: IMPENETRABLE BASTION
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

detachments.name: Grav-Assault Force
detachments.legend: Swift and agile, Adeptus Custodes grav-vehicles can inflict untold destruction.

rules.name: Flare Shields
rules.description: Friendly GRAV-ASSAULT units have 4+ InSv against ranged attacks.

enhancements.name: Anti-gravitic Mobility (Upgrade)
enhancements.description: GRAV-ASSAULT unit only. When this unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.

enhancements.name: Combat Deployment (Upgrade)
enhancements.description:
GRAV-ASSAULT TRANSPORT model only. When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a disembark move from this unit, until the end of the turn:

  • That unit can re-roll charge rolls.
  • Enemy units cannot target that unit with snap shooting attacks.

stratagems.name: VICTORY BEFORE DEATH
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit within range of an objective is destroyed.

TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is destroyed.

EFFECT: Select one objective that:
  • Your unit was controlling when it was destroyed.
  • Has no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT units) within range of it.
That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: ADVANCED STABILISERS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault].

stratagems.name: INEVITABLE ANNIHILATION
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • BS.
  • Hit rolls.

detachments.name: Guardians of the Throne
detachments.legend: Few foes can stand against a combined-arms force of Custodians.

rules.name: Martial Mastery
rules.description:
In the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to fight, that unit’s melee attacks have:
  • [Sustained Hits 1].
  • Or: [Lethal Hits].

enhancements.name: Castellan's Mark
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Eagle's Eye
enhancements.description:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only.

  • This model has +1 W.
  • (Once per battle, per army) When attacks are allocated to this model, you can use this ability. If you do, this model has 3+ InSv.

stratagems.name: SHIELD OF HONOUR
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy model engaged with your unit selects targets, if that enemy model does not select your unit as the target of all of its attacks, that enemy model’s attacks have:
  • -1 to hit rolls.
  • -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: SUPERHUMAN FOCUS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of any phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not readied.

EFFECT: Your unit is readied.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: IN AURAMITE CLAD
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding CUSTODIAN WARDENS units).

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: PRIME TARGET
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks can:
  • Re-roll one hit roll.
  • Re-roll one wound roll.
  • Re-roll one damage roll.

stratagems.name: UNLIMITED ENDURANCE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit ends an advance move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn:
  • Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault].
  • That advance move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.

TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

rules.name: Companion’s Watch
rules.description: While a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit is within range of an objective, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Arae-Shrike
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Enemy units that are selected to make an ingress move cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

enhancements.name: Celeritous Sentries (Upgrade)
enhancements.description:
TRUSTED SENTINEL unit only. (Once per phase, per unit) You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do:

  • That use is -1 CP.
  • That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

stratagems.name: EMPEROR'S DOMAIN
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.

EFFECT: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.

stratagems.name: AVENGE THE FALLEN
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit that is below starting strength is selected to fight.

TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks (excluding those made by CHARACTER models) have +2 A.

stratagems.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.

TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

detachments.name: Lions of the Emperor
detachments.legend: Many of the galaxy’s warrior cultures accept the time-honoured truth that there is greater strength in numbers. Not so for the champions of the Adeptus Custodes, the Lions of the Emperor. Each of them is an army unto themselves, a warrior of legend gifted with terrifying strength, armoured in nigh-impenetrable golden plate and possessing limitless resolve. When the greatest Custodians take to the field at once, those auric-armoured champions have no need to pool their resources in order to smite their foes. Relying instead upon their superhuman strength and mastery of martial ka’tahs, they hurl themselves into the midst of the enemy, sweeping aside gunlines, eviscerating rampaging monsters and obliterating enemy war machines with terrifying ease.

rules.name: Against All Odds
rules.description: Each time a model in an Adeptus Custodes unit from your army (excluding Vehicles) makes an attack, if there are no other friendly units within 6" of that unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Praesidius
enhancements.description: Adeptus Custodes model only. The bearer has the Lone Operative and Stealth abilities.

enhancements.name: Fierce Conqueror
enhancements.description: Shield-Captain model only. At the start of the Fight phase, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer for every 5 enemy models within 6" of the bearer (rounding down).

enhancements.name: Admonimortis
enhancements.description: Shield-Captain model only. Improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 3, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of those weapons by 1.

stratagems.name: PEERLESS WARRIOR
stratagems.type: Lions of the Emperor – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
stratagems.type: Lions of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: UNLEASH THE LIONS
stratagems.type: Lions of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One Allarus Custodians or Aquilon Custodians unit from your army that is on the battlefield.

EFFECT: That unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.

stratagems.name: DEFIANT TO THE LAST
stratagems.type: Lions of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if that model has the CHARACTER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is treated as having 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: GILDED CHAMPION
stratagems.type: Lions of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an Adeptus Custodes Character model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet that states it can only be used ‘once per battle’.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.

EFFECT: Your model can use that ‘once per battle’ ability one additional time during the battle (but not in the same phase).

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: MANOEUVRE AND FIRE
stratagems.type: Lions of the Emperor – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

detachments.name: Might of the Moritoi
detachments.legend: Auramite-clad Dreadnoughts stride into the foe and crush them with ancient weaponry.

rules.name: March of the Honoured Dead
rules.description: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER units have +2" M and +1 to Advance rolls and Charge rolls. This detachment has the ARMOURY tag and cannot be taken with another ARMOURY detachment.

enhancements.name: Interred Expertise (Upgrade)
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit only. This unit's attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Auramite Sarcophagus (Upgrade)
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit only. When you target this unit with the Crushing Impact stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

stratagems.name: Flawless Construction
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit's T have -1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Advance
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit is selected to move. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Prioritised Eradication
stratagems.description: WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to shoot. TARGET: That unit. EFFECT: Your unit's Arachnus Storm Cannon weapons have [RAPID FIRE 6] and Iliastus Accelerator Culverin weapons have [RAPID FIRE 2].

rules.name: Creeping Dread (Aura)
rules.description:
In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, if an enemy unit that is either a PSYKER unit or below its Starting Strength is within 12" of one or more Anathema Psykana models from your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that unit is Below Half-strength, it must subtract 1 from its Battle-shock test this phase instead.

Designer’s Note: This means that all enemy PSYKER units within range of this Aura ability and all enemy units within range of this Aura ability that have lost one or more models must take a Battle-shock test in your opponents Command phase, not just those that are Below Half-strength.

enhancements.name: Enhanced Voidsheen Cloak
enhancements.description: Anathema Psykana model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack. If that attack was made by a PSYKER or Battle-shocked model, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1 instead.

enhancements.name: Huntress’ Eye
enhancements.description: Anathema Psykana model only. In your Command phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.description: Anathema Psykana model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that attack targeted an enemy PSYKER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.name: Raptor Blade
enhancements.description: Anathema Psykana model only. Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearers melee weapons. While the bearer is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy PSYKER units that are Battle-shocked, add 2 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons instead.

stratagems.name: PURGATION SWEEP
stratagems.type: Null Maiden Vigil – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Witchseekers unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit. If such a weapon targets a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit this phase, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic instead.

stratagems.name: ANATHEMA BLADEMASTERY
stratagems.type: Null Maiden Vigil – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One Vigilators unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll If the target of that attack is Battle-shocked or a PSYKER, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.name: WITCH HUNTERS
stratagems.type: Null Maiden Vigil – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One Anathema Psykana unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability, but models in your unit can only target PSYKER units with their attacks.

stratagems.name: PSY-CHAFF VOLLEY
stratagems.type: Null Maiden Vigil – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Prosecutors unit from your army that has just shot.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while your unit is on the battlefield, that enemy unit is prosecuted. While a unit is prosecuted, each time an Anathema Psykana model makes an attack against that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. While a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit is prosecuted, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: DESPERATION’S PRICE
stratagems.type: Null Maiden Vigil – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an enemy PSYKER unit has either finished using a Psychic ability that targets a unit, or finished making Psychic Attacks.

TARGET: One Anathema Psykana unit from your army within 18" of that enemy PSYKER unit.

EFFECT: That enemy PSYKER unit must take a Leadership test If the test is passed, that PSYKER unit is Battle-shocked; if the test is failed that PSYKER unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: PSYCHIC ABOMINATIONS
stratagems.type: Null Maiden Vigil – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Anathema Psykana Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and Battle-shocked and PSYKER models can only select your unit as a target of a ranged attack if they are within 12".

detachments.name: Shadowkeepers
detachments.legend: The Shadowkeepers seek to destroy or contain that which should not be.

rules.name: Wardens of the Dark Cells
rules.description:
While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) is within range of an objective, melee attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Favoured ka’tah: KAPTARIS
Additional Effect: You can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

enhancements.name: Unstoppable Destroyer
enhancements.description:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. When this unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move:

  • This unit can move up to 4".
  • You can select any consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

enhancements.name: Genalchemic Warding
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

stratagems.name: GRIM RESPONSIBILITY
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: Character/Monster].

stratagems.name: NO ESCAPE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: INDOMITABLE GUARDIANS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.

EFFECT: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

detachments.name: Solar Watch
detachments.legend: Guardians of the Sol System, the Solar Watch favour rapid warfare.

rules.name: Talon Sortie
rules.description:
When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to charge.

Favoured ka’tah: CALISTUS
Additional Effect: Your unit has +2" M.

enhancements.name: Sally Forth
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES SHIELD-CAPTAIN model only. At the start of your Charge phase, select one friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit within 6" of this model. If that unit made an advance move this turn, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Auric Eagle (Upgrade)
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit only (excluding TERMINATOR units). This unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • M.
  • Advance rolls and charge rolls.

stratagems.name: AT SPEAR'S LENGTH
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: GRAVIMETRIC GRENADE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
